_comment: Lighting & Shadow Harmonization PIPELINE CONFIG (Phase 10). This is NOT a ComfyUI/SDXL graph — lighting harmonization is a fast CPU/OpenCV post-process, never a diffusion re-render. The config lives here (not hardcoded in Python): backend/lighting_manager.py loads it and backend/comfy_lighting.py executes the listed stages with these parameters. `strength` is the global blend (0=no change, 1=full match); each stage has its own enabled flag + strength so the engine stays tunable without code changes.
